Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AVGO.
Operating income reached $9.5 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Revenue guidance of $25.1 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2021.
Our cloud segment grew 15% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 15% to 8% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1892 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 15% to 8% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
